findings.summary: Dev-note input_commit records 925a2bdfab0e9682687952a8f5500b18b4c5581d (the implement handoff's input_commit) rather than this attempt's dispatch input_commit (854d5ceeae5b4bad25a1a5a6f232d0d10bb894af). Spec §5 item 4 requires the dev-note input_commit to be the dispatch's input_commit. This is the same minor audit-trail identity finding noted (and tolerated under APPROVE) in attempts 1, 2, and 3; it does not affect product code correctness. The core defect (triage result read-back via pre-spawn snapshot) is correctly fixed: readTriageResult re-reads the channel per call (src/tick-inspect.ts:350-356), the production readResult uses it with 30×1s retry and loud failure naming runId (src/tick-run.ts:1521-1530), findTriageResult properly distinguishes null (read failure) from [] (empty decisions) (src/tick-inspect.ts:328-342), applyTriageBatch accepts and propagates the real runId (src/tick-run.ts:858-925), and a production-assembly test (no spawnTriage/triageSpawnRuntime injection) drives the production default branch (test/g5-triage-read.test.ts:656-715). Prior rf review's P7 blocker root cause (yaml being a declared-but-uninstalled devDependency causing 10 test files to fail collection) is resolved — yaml is now in package.json devDependencies, and vite-node resolves transitively via vitest in the lockfile.
